about: Draft formats consumed by the generic draft engine (src/draftState.js). A format is data: phases, side order per phase, timers and rules. Order tokens: 'b'/'r' = blue/red side; 'a'/'e' = your side/enemy side (resolved from the side you play). Picks record ORDER only; roles are assigned separately. Ban legality is per format: banMode 'blind' (Ranked: bans in simultaneous waves, the same hero may be banned by both sides within a wave, availability updates when the wave is revealed), 'sequential' (Tournament: visible, unique bans), 'free'. allowNoBan enables an explicit 'No ban' event.

RANKED_DRAFT.note: Everyday live-logging mode, verified in-game: 5 + 5 blind bans upfront (duplicates and 'No ban' allowed), then picks B1 · R2 · B2 · R2 · B2 · R1. There is no second ban phase. Picks are hero-first with inferred, switchable roles.

confirmed: Ban/pick runs in the game client's Tournament Mode (EWC 2026 MLBB rulebook §5.4.1, document shared with Moonton).
A hero Swap Phase follows the picks; swaps are final once it ends (same rulebook §5.5.5).
Side selection: coin toss for game 1, then the loser of the previous game chooses (same rulebook §5.5.3).
10 bans per game, 5 per side (S18 hero-stat table: 1,720 bans over 172 drafts).
unconfirmed: Exact per-action order (3+3 bans, B/RR/BB/R snake picks, 2+2 bans, R/BB/R picks): matches the client's Tournament Mode as described by third-party draft tools, not by an official MPL PH S18 document.
Timer values: not published in the sources found; 30s per action is a placeholder.
verification.howToConfirm: Compare against the ordered ban/pick log of any S18 game (e.g. Liquipedia match drafts or the broadcast) and update 'order' / 'timer' here.
